data.description: Analyze your viewing preferences and accurately recommend movies from your NAS library
data.descriptionEn: Analyze your viewing preferences and accurately recommend movies from your NAS library
data.descriptionZh: 分析你的观影口味，从NAS片库精准推荐你想看的片
data.readme:
· Recommend films or series based on your favorites, recently watched, recent updates, and explicit preferences.
· Find movies by genre, theme, year, region, family, weekend, kids, and other scenarios
· Recommendations are strictly selected from your local library; no external resources are fabricated
data.readmeEn:
· Recommend films or series based on your favorites, recently watched, recent updates, and explicit preferences.
· Find movies by genre, theme, year, region, family, weekend, kids, and other scenarios
· Recommendations are strictly selected from your local library; no external resources are fabricated
data.readmeZh:
· 根据你的收藏、最近观看、最近更新和明确偏好推荐本地可看的影片
· 支持按类型、题材、年份、地区、家庭、周末、小朋友观看等场景找片
· 推荐结果只从你的本地影视库里选，不编造库外资源
